fields.name: start_marker
fields.meaning: Block start marker, always 2; loading rejects the save if it is not 2
fields.evidence: code: writer b000:ddc3 sets it, checker b000:dead tests it (returns 1); blank->save diff (0 -> 02)

fields.name: body_length
fields.meaning: Length of the save body: 0x06AC (1708). The end marker sits at 0x003+length and the checksum right after it
fields.evidence: code b000:ddc3 / b000:dead; all three natural saves hold ac 06

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Game ID text 'BRAVETAMER_V001' plus a zero byte, copied from the cartridge; loading compares the first 15 bytes and treats a mismatch as no save
fields.evidence: code: writer b000:df4c copies ROM 9828:000C (16 bytes), loader b000:e159 compares 15 bytes against ROM 9828:000C; ROM bytes verified

fields.name: unknown_a86
fields.meaning: Unknown game value (zeroed at new game; no direct code users found in the full instruction dump)
fields.evidence: code: copied with the 0x013 block from RAM 0xCA86 (b000:df4c), cleared by new-game init b000:c2ac; 0 in all saves

fields.name: unknown_a88
fields.meaning: Unknown game value (zeroed at new game)
fields.evidence: code: b000:c2ac clears RAM 0xCA88; 0 in all saves

fields.name: id_list
fields.meaning: List of up to 50 two-byte entry numbers (51 slots kept), 0xFFFF = empty; entry numbers fall in four ranges (0-32, 33-56, 57-157, 158-288), most likely the owned items/cards by kind
fields.evidence: code: c000:14fa fills with 0xFFFF, c000:1504 appends (max 50), c000:1548 removes (swap-with-last), c000:003f splits numbers into 4 kinds; all saves all 0xFFFF (nothing owned yet)

fields.name: id_list_count
fields.meaning: Number of used entries in the list above (maximum 50)
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xCAF0 is the count in c000:1504/1548; 0 in all saves

fields.name: unknown_af1
fields.meaning: Two unknown values zeroed at new game
fields.evidence: code: b000:c2ac clears RAM 0xCAF1 and 0xCAF3; 0 in all saves

fields.name: unknown_af5
fields.meaning: Unknown, part of the same RAM block
fields.evidence: copied with block RAM 0xCA86-0xCBB9; 0 in all saves

fields.name: unknown_b0d
fields.meaning: Unknown value zeroed at new game
fields.evidence: code: b000:c2ac clears RAM 0xCB0D; 0 in all saves

fields.name: unknown_b0e
fields.meaning: Unknown, part of the same RAM block
fields.evidence: 0 in all saves

fields.name: player_name
fields.meaning: Player (tamer) name in the game's own text code, ended by 0xFF; dialogue inserts it where the script has the name marker. All saves hold the default name from the cartridge
fields.evidence: code: e000:4a8a copies RAM 0xCB21 into dialogue at marker 0xFA; b000:c2ac copies the 6-byte default from ROM 9825:0006 (bytes verified: 81 a8 5c ff ff ff)

fields.name: unknown_b27
fields.meaning: Unknown remainder of the RAM block 0xCA86-0xCBB9 (one byte read with an index by the field routine e000:2bd2; the byte at block +0x92 is set to 8 and compared by the title code d000:d4e3)
fields.evidence: copied by b000:df4c; 0 in all saves

fields.name: party_records_3x109
fields.encoding: u8 active flag + u16le id word at +12, rest unknown
fields.meaning: Three records of 109 bytes each, one per party follower (RAM 0xC932, 0xC99F, 0xCA0C); a slot counts as used when its byte at +0 and its word at +12 are both nonzero; other code compares words at +0/+4/+10/+14, bytes at +16..+22 and a flag bit at +29
fields.evidence: code: b000:c2ac clears +0 of each; e000:416f maps used slots to follower sprites; e000:2919 and f000:ce0f gate events on them; c000:0285 indexes them (index*0x6D+0x932); status screen shows 3 member rows; all 0 in all saves

fields.name: party_follow_flag
fields.meaning: Party flag: when 0 the three followers are drawn as the default type; also read by battle/menu code
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xCA7A tested by party setup e000:416f, read at c000:0bf0, d000:6aa8, d000:6c7f; 0 in all saves

fields.name: unknown_records_15x65
fields.meaning: Fifteen records of 65 bytes each (RAM 0xF2D8); no code in the disassembled game reads or writes them except saving, loading and new-game setup, so their purpose is unknown
fields.evidence: code: b000:c2ac clears byte 0 of each; full instruction dump has no other references; all 0 in all saves

fields.name: block_head16
fields.meaning: 16 bytes copied from the cartridge at new game (23 23 then zeros); purpose unknown
fields.evidence: code: f000:795c copies ROM ABD1:0006 (bytes verified); all saves match the ROM default

fields.name: menu_mode
fields.meaning: Switch that picks a 2-entry or a 7-entry menu
fields.evidence: code: f000:7701 / f000:77e2 test RAM 0xFA0C; f000:7975 clears it; 0 in all saves

fields.name: menu_slots9
fields.meaning: Nine slots, 0xFF = empty
fields.evidence: code: f000:7975 fills RAM 0xFA0D.. with 0xFF; all saves all 0xFF

fields.name: tail_byte
fields.meaning: Unknown byte at the end of the block
fields.evidence: 0 in all saves

fields.name: lookup_key8
fields.meaning: Eight-byte value matched against an 8-entry table (entries 26 bytes apart); the match position or 0xFF (no match) is the result
fields.evidence: code: f000:7b97 compares RAM 0xFA17..0xFA1E; 0 in all saves

fields.name: map_id
fields.meaning: Current area / map number; the field code branches on it (values 0-14 seen)
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF10E read by e000:0143/e000:0ad2 compares; 0 in all saves

fields.name: story_progress
fields.meaning: Story progress counter; the story dispatcher both advances it and switches on it to run each story step
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF114, dispatcher f000:c880 increments it per step (many INC sites), compares drive the story; new game sets 0, saves hold 1

fields.name: event_flags
fields.meaning: Event flag bits (bits 5-7 tested; the scripted save clears bits 5-7 first)
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF116, e000:02f1 tests 0x20/0x40/0x80, f000:da4b ANDs 0x1F; 0 in all saves

fields.name: view_x
fields.meaning: Map view left edge (in tiles); added to the party X positions to get map positions
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF192, e000:0fee adds it to RAM 0xF1B8; passed to the map drawer e000:3f5d with a 28x18 window

fields.name: view_y
fields.meaning: Map view top edge (in tiles); new game sets 22
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF196; all saves 0x16

fields.name: saved_view_x
fields.meaning: Copy of the view X kept by an event as a return point
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF194, e000:1c95 copies view_x into it

fields.name: saved_view_y
fields.meaning: Copy of the view Y kept by an event as a return point; new game sets 22
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF198, e000:1c9b copies view_y; all saves 0x16

fields.name: party_x
fields.meaning: X positions (tiles, inside the view) of the 4 party characters on the map (leader first); new game sets 8
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF1B8, e000:0fee adds view_x, e000:416f draws sprites from it; diffs across the three saves track walking

fields.name: party_y
fields.meaning: Y positions (tiles, inside the view) of the 4 party characters; new game sets 12
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF1BC, e000:0ffa adds view_y; diffs across the three saves track walking/regrouping

fields.name: field_mode
fields.meaning: Field state switch; while set, a once-per-minute countdown timer runs
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF18C tested by the clock routine b000:4ee3 and the field code; 0 in all saves

fields.name: unknown_f110
fields.meaning: Unknown byte compared with 9 and 10 by the field code
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF110, e000:0585/e000:0a75; 0 in all saves

fields.name: unknown_f10c
fields.meaning: Unknown byte read by the field code
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF10C read in e000:0143; 0 in all saves

fields.name: flags_5
fields.meaning: Five flag bytes cleared together with the story reset
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF12A, cleared by b000:c2ac and e000:2d3e; 0 in all saves

fields.name: flags_7
fields.meaning: Seven flag bytes (one is toggled with XOR by the field code)
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF11C, e000:28c6 XOR; 0 in all saves

fields.name: event_flag_word
fields.meaning: Story-script bit flags set one by one (bits 0, 1, 2, 13, 14, 15 and computed bits seen)
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xF118, f000:c880 ORs bits (f000:cb7e/cc6a/cd4f and [/'U/'X branches); 0 in all saves

fields.name: timer_seconds
fields.meaning: Seconds part of the play timer (0-59), counted once per second (every 75 frames)
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xC91A, clock b000:4e98 (divides frame count by 0x4B); 18 -> 39 -> 51 across the three saves

fields.name: timer_minutes
fields.meaning: Minutes part of the play timer, stops at 300; some story steps reset the timer to 0
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0xC918, clock b000:4ed0 caps at 0x12C, dispatcher f000:c880 ('s' branch) resets it; 0 -> 1 -> 2 across the three saves

fields.name: padding
fields.meaning: Zero bytes written by the save routine
fields.evidence: code: b000:df4c writes 12 zeros at 0x6A4-0x6AF (last one then covered by the end marker); all saves zero

fields.name: end_marker
fields.meaning: Block end marker, always 3; loading rejects the save if it is not 3
fields.evidence: code: b000:ddc3 writes it at 0x003+length, b000:dead tests it (returns 2); all saves 03

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: CRC-16/KERMIT (reflected 0x1021, start 0, no final XOR) over bytes 0x001-0x6AF, stored low byte first
fields.evidence: code: b000:1f28 table CRC (tables at b000:1F68/2068 = byte-swapped KERMIT table); recomputed on all three natural saves: all match

fields.name: unused_gap
fields.meaning: Not written by the save
fields.evidence: all saves zero; writer length is 0x6B2

fields.name: cleared_area
fields.meaning: Cleared to zero after every save
fields.evidence: code: b000:e3f5 writes 8 zero words at word address 0x380; all saves zero

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.meaning: Not touched by the game
fields.evidence: no writer in the full instruction dump; all saves zero

fields.name: console_owner_data
fields.meaning: Console owner profile; not written by the game save
fields.evidence: identical across every state in the tree
